summary: The rules restrict workspace reads and writes to the authenticated UID, validate all top-level fields on both create and update, enforce a size cap and sequential versions, and deny all other paths. A client can still put malformed JSON inside its own private payload because rules cannot validate the contents of a JSON string. Live emulator and cross-account checks remain pending.

findings.issue: The owner may save malformed JSON inside its own payload, which can make that owner's workspace unreadable in the app.
findings.recommendation: Split the workspace into typed item documents as the app grows, then validate each item's fields in rules. Until then, keep client-side validation and a recovery path for invalid owner data.
